_readme: Doctoral training programmes (DTPs, CDTs and DLA hubs) shown on /doctoral-training/.
Only put facts here that you have checked on the programme's own site or in its adverts. Leave a field out rather than guess.
type: DTP, CDT or DLA. funder: the UKRI council(s). partners: universities and institutes, lead first if known.
match: regular expressions (case-sensitive) tested against each advert's title, summary and the first 500 characters of its description.
match_i: the same, but case-insensitive. anywhere: true also searches the whole description (use only for distinctive names, because passing mentions creep in).
A programme gets its own page when at least one open advert matches; the rest are listed on the hub with a link to their site.
